The U+0001..U+001F range intentionally removes C0 control characters from file names. U+202E and the punctuation are separate explicitly forbidden characters. The broad control range is required sanitization, not an accidental A-z style range.

calcHash is a fixed-width 64-bit protocol hash. Shift/XOR mixing and hash + id intentionally use Java long wraparound. The result is not used as an allocation size or array bound. Checked sticker-hash callers; adding overflow rejection would change protocol output.

All seven SvgHelper parsers use SvgXmlReader.create(): external general/parameter entities disabled, rejecting EntityResolver, and lexical startDTD throws. UTF-8/16 file/HTTP/DTD/entity regression tests pass with zero HTTP requests. CodeQL misses these helper protections.
